name: Élodie Girard
title: Principal Data Engineer
summary: Principal Data Engineer with 12+ years of experience designing and operating large-scale data platforms across cloud and hybrid environments. Strong track record in building reliable analytics foundations, improving data quality, and leading Python-driven engineering teams delivering measurable business impact.

bullets: Led the modernization of a 120+ TB enterprise data platform on AWS and Snowflake, reducing batch processing time by 48%.
Designed Python-based orchestration and data quality frameworks that lowered critical pipeline incidents by 35% year over year.
Mentored a team of 8 data engineers and standardized engineering practices across 4 product squads.
Built and maintained a cloud data lake for a major retail client, ingesting 2.5 billion events per month with Apache Spark and Kafka.
Implemented CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code patterns with Terraform, cutting deployment lead time from days to under 1 hour.
Delivered reusable Python ETL components adopted by 6 project teams, improving development speed by 30%.
Developed analytics pipelines for product and growth teams, enabling self-service dashboards used by 200+ stakeholders.
Optimized SQL and Spark workloads to reduce daily pipeline runtimes by 40% while improving data freshness to under 15 minutes.
Collaborated with data scientists to productionize experimentation datasets and feature pipelines.
Created reporting and integration solutions for public-sector clients using SQL Server and ETL tooling.
Supported migration of legacy reporting assets to a more scalable data warehouse architecture.
Improved data reconciliation processes, reducing manual correction effort by 25%.

education.degree: Master's Degree in Computer Science, Data Systems
